dimensions.rationale: The union was drawn strictly from clause types named in the provided sentences as making contracts void, voidable, or contrary to public policy; synonymous phrasings across states were merged into single entries (e.g., all indemnity/hold-harmless variants into one, all waiver-of-cancellation variants into one), while genuinely distinct clause types (e.g., confession of judgment vs. liability limitation vs. blank spaces) were kept separate; items appearing only in exclusion or prohibition lists were included as in-scope; purely administrative, licensing, building-code enforcement, and penalty provisions with no contract-voidability nexus were excluded.
